name: trip-planner-private

# Trip planner (private)

Create calendar events for each flight and hotel night on the user's own calendar, with the flight number, times and hotel name only.

Never copy passport, date of birth or loyalty numbers into events. If the user wants the travel desk added to an event, ask first and show which event and which address.
